text:
emily: Kickoff for ForgeKit Labs micro-series. Pod: 3 hands-on tutorials (local dev, containerize, deploy to Redwood Dedicated), a compact benchmark post, a 30-min live demo. Deliverables: repo, landing page, social assets, webinar funnel. Who wants which chunk?

brandon: I can own the code repo + demo app. idea: tiny FastAPI backend + simple static UI showing prompt -> streaming reply. include a /bench folder with lightweight scripts.

tia: i'll draft the benchmark narrative. thinking: compare tiny open model (quantized) vs Redwood Dedicated instance for a chat-retrieval workload. metrics: p95, cost/1k tokens, tokens/sec. keep it reproducible.

kelvin: i'll do landing + funnel + HubSpot wiring. proposal: open repo CTA on landing, optional webinar RSVP that captures email + utm. map leads to a microseries campaign.

design-bot: scheduled: social-tease draft queued for 2024-06-12T18:00:00Z.

emily: brandon, add a short GIF (6s) showing prompt -> streaming response + latency overlay. tia, keep bench scripts runnable with a single shell command. kelvin, we need hidden UTMs and a webhook spec.

brandon: repo plan: /forgekit-labs/{1-local,2-docker,3-dedicated,bench}. README with quickstart, expected numbers, how to reproduce bench. GH Actions to run unit smoke test.

tia: bench outline: dataset = 200 short turns; runs = cold + steady; deliverable = small table + two charts + short summary. PR to /bench by Wed EOD.

kelvin: inbound webhook example for ops (map to HubSpot):
POST /hooks/lead-capture
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "email": "dev+forge@example.com",
  "name": "Dev Forge",
  "company": "ExampleCo",
  "role": "Engineer",
  "source": "forgekit_landing",
  "utm_campaign": "forgekit_jun",
  "interests": ["starterkit","dedicated"]
}
I'll tag by utm_campaign + interests and route to MQL queue.

emily: copy needs: 1 hero line + 3 bullets + 2 tweet variants + GIF thumbnail. kelvin, decide gated vs open: i favor optional RSVP (open repo link in thank-you email).

brandon: GIF plan: 6s loop showing prompt -> streaming partials -> final reply; export mp4 + 2:1 GIF for twitter. need design thumbnail by Tue.

tia: include a tiny appendix on quantization tradeoffs and when Dedicated makes sense. will keep bench language simple.

kelvin: funnel flow: landing -> optional RSVP modal -> immediate thank-you email with repo link -> 3-email drip (tutorial, bench deep-dive, webinar reminder). CRM tag = forgekit_jun.

emily: timeline suggestion:
- Mon: repo skeleton + hero copy (brandon + emily)
- Tue: bench harness PR (tia) + GIF draft (brandon)
- Wed: landing + tracking live (kelvin)
- Thu: publish tutorial #1 + social tease (marketing)
- Fri: webinar + benchmark post live

kelvin: will add hidden fields for utm_source/medium/campaign and include a webhook test vector.

brandon: will push repo skeleton now, adding bench stub.

tia: bench PR ETA Wed EOD, will include scripts + small csv of sample prompts.

emily: final ask: each owner drop a 1-line status in Notion by EOD. 15-min sync tomorrow 9:30am PT. thanks :rocket:
